**Tier:** T2 (T3 if it destroys, eradicates, disables or overwrites)  

Update properties for global admin settings.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|

**Request body** (required): `AdminSetting`

| Field | Type | Description |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `AdminSettingsResponse`
